drivers.name: net_income_to_common
drivers.source_kpi: Net income attributable to common stockholders

takeaways: Revenue increased by $3.159 million, led by a $4.563 million increase in commercial/industrial revenue.
Net income improved by $4.335 million to $2.635 million, turning profitable.
Adjusted EBITDA increased by $2.686 million to $8.386 million; mineral resources and farming revenue also rose.
data.summary: Reported second-quarter results show broad-based revenue growth, improved profitability, and higher Adjusted EBITDA, while occupancy, Terra Vista leasing, and liquidity remain unchanged due to no reported KPI.
